summary: Build a simple app to generate complete product files (PDFs and downloadable assets) for three digital AI-automation products, suitable for uploading to Gumroad or Etsy.
architectural_notes: Simple app that outputs PDFs and packaged downloadable assets intended for Gumroad/Etsy distribution.
Product themes selected for the three digital products: (1) Digital Planners, (2) Canva Templates (social/business/branding bundles), (3) Printable Wall Art (high-volume Etsy style).
known_issues: Instructions view is not scrollable; users cannot scroll to see the full instructions list.
Instructions popup/modal is still not scrollable on tablet devices; user cannot scroll to see full instructions.
Deployment/build is failing (deployment error); may be transient in the current environment.
Current visual theme/layout appears too bland; needs more color accents in the UI.
Product Editor page styling regressed: page background is completely white and prior blue button styling is missing (user prefers original design).
Instructions popup/modal styling regressed: popup is transparent and hard to read.

existing_features.title: Create a frontend workflow to define and manage three digital product entries (title, subtitle, description, included modules/chapters, prompts/templates/checklists, and optional branding fields), with an editor UI that supports saving drafts locally and regenerating outputs on demand.

Generate complete product files for each of the three products as downloadable assets, including at minimum: (1) a multi-page PDF document and (2) a structured bundle of supplementary files (e.g., TXT/MD templates, checklists, prompt packs) packaged into a single ZIP per product.

Provide a “Gumroad/Etsy export” screen that summarizes the generated deliverables for each product (what’s included, file sizes, and a preview thumbnail), and offers one-click download per product plus a “Download all products” option that creates a single ZIP containing all three product ZIPs.

Add a lightweight backend canister API to store/retrieve product definitions and generation metadata (e.g., last generated time, version tag) so the app can persist product content beyond the browser and support multi-device use with Internet Identity login.

Apply a coherent, distinctive visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) appropriate for a “digital product generator” tool, and keep all user-facing text in English.
Add in-app previews: a quick PDF preview (first pages or a rendered preview panel) and a ZIP content preview (tree/list of files that will be included) before downloading.
Include static generated brand/cover imagery for the three products (one cover image per product) as part of the downloadable bundle, and render these images in the UI as preview thumbnails.

Add an in-app, step-by-step instructions section (English) that explains how to use the app end-to-end (edit products, generate bundles, preview, and download), and how to upload the generated files to Gumroad and to Etsy.

Include the same step-by-step usage + Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions inside the generated downloadable documentation by expanding the README content produced for each product ZIP and the master all-products ZIP.
Add a first-launch onboarding modal that automatically opens the first time a user opens the app in a given browser and presents the app usage + Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions inside the app.

Ensure the onboarding modal does not block required first-time profile setup: if the profile setup dialog is shown (authenticated user with no profile), show profile setup first; only show the onboarding modal after profile setup is complete or if profile setup is not needed.
Provide a persistent way for users to re-open the onboarding instructions modal after dismissing it (for example, a header link/button labeled "Instructions" or "Help").
Add a quick-access, always-visible header button labeled "Export" that takes the user to the existing Export screen for downloading generated product files.
Wire the new header "Export" button into the existing view state so it correctly switches between editor and export views while preserving the currently generated bundles in memory.
Fix the Instructions UI so users can scroll to view the full instructions content in all places it is shown (the onboarding instructions modal and the Export screen instructions section).

Fix the onboarding Instructions popup (OnboardingInstructionsModal) so the full instructions content is scrollable on tablet browsers using touch scrolling (e.g., iPad/Android tablets), including when switching between the App Usage / Gumroad / Etsy tabs.

Ensure the Export screen’s embedded instructions section is also reliably scrollable on tablet devices (touch scrolling) without trapping scroll or preventing users from reaching all instruction content.

Update the onboarding instructions modal so the popup (dialog) resizes responsively to fit different screen sizes (phone/tablet/desktop), using responsive Tailwind classes on the existing DialogContent wrapper in frontend/src/components/onboarding/OnboardingInstructionsModal.tsx.

Add a subtle fade-in animation to the onboarding instructions modal content so the dialog smoothly appears when opened (with a short duration and minimal motion), and ensure the animation is disabled when the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled.

Replace the current default three products with the three highest-profit themes (Digital Planner, Canva Templates, Printable Wall Art) and prefill each product with complete starter content (name, subtitle, description, modules, AI prompts, templates, and checklists) so the app ships with ready-to-generate products on first launch.

Update the generated master bundle README content to remove the hard-coded “Automation Products Bundle” naming and instead describe a neutral multi-product digital bundle that matches the three default themes (planner, templates, wall art) while keeping all user-facing text in English.
Eliminate reliance on CDN-loaded global scripts for jsPDF and JSZip by bundling them via the frontend build system, so the app builds and deploys reliably without external runtime dependencies.
Ensure the project builds and deploys successfully after the dependency change, with clear user-facing error handling if PDF or ZIP generation fails at runtime (English only).

Update the app’s default three products so they match the previously selected themes (Digital Planner, Canva Templates, Printable Wall Art) and ensure each default product is prefilled with complete starter content (name, subtitle, description, modules/chapters, AI prompts, templates, and checklists) so users can generate all three fully built products immediately on first launch.

Prevent existing local drafts from unintentionally overriding the updated default products by bumping the local draft storage version/key and providing a safe fallback behavior (e.g., treat older draft versions as incompatible and start from the new defaults).
Add a new in-app “Unified Preview” screen that displays all three products together in a single combined layout, suitable for quickly reviewing the full bundle at once.

In the Unified Preview screen, show an in-app PDF preview for each generated product using the already-generated PDF blobs when available, and show a clear empty state when a product has not been generated yet.
Wire the Unified Preview screen into the existing view-state flow so users can enter and exit it without losing the currently generated bundles in memory.

Add a new in-app “Storefront” screen that presents the three products in a polished storefront-style layout for browsing and review, showing each product’s cover image, name, subtitle, and a short description with an expand/collapse option.
Wire the new Storefront screen into the existing view-state flow in frontend/src/App.tsx so users can enter and exit it without losing the currently generated bundles in memory.

Add a persistent header navigation entry (button or link) labeled “Storefront” in frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx that routes to the new Storefront screen, and ensure the existing “Export” / “Unified Preview” / “Instructions” controls continue to work as before.
From the Storefront screen, provide a clear action for each product to open the Product Editor with that product selected (active tab set to the chosen product).

Refine the Storefront screen’s visual structure to improve hierarchy, spacing, and responsiveness while keeping the existing layout and functionality intact (no new features). Update the header area and the product grid layout to feel more polished across mobile/tablet/desktop.

Refine the Storefront product card visual design for readability and scanability: improve cover image presentation, title/subtitle/description spacing, and CTA emphasis using existing Tailwind theme tokens (background/foreground/muted/border) and existing UI components (Card/Button).
Ensure Storefront visual refinements remain consistent with the app’s global theme (Tailwind CSS variables and shadcn components) and keep all user-facing text in English.

Refine the global layout styling to improve hierarchy, spacing, and responsive behavior across the app shell (header, main container, and footer) while keeping all existing navigation and functionality unchanged.

Polish the Product Editor UI styling (frontend/src/components/products/ProductEditor.tsx) for readability and scanability: improve spacing between form sections, align primary actions, and ensure consistent typography across tabs and empty states.

Polish the Export screen UI styling (frontend/src/components/export/ExportScreen.tsx) to improve visual clarity of the download actions, bundle cards, and the embedded instructions panel, without changing export logic or download behavior.

Polish the Unified Preview screen UI styling (frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedPreviewScreen.tsx) to improve card consistency, cover presentation, and description expand/collapse affordances, while preserving existing preview behavior and empty states.

Update the app’s visible branding strings to be sale-ready and consistent across the shell: change the header title in frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx and the HTML document title in frontend/index.html to a neutral, product-agnostic name (no “Automation Product Pack” wording).

Make the exported file names sale-ready and accurate by using the actual product display name (from DEFAULT_PRODUCTS) rather than constructing names from product IDs in frontend/src/components/export/ExportScreen.tsx, so PDFs and ZIPs do not get names like “product-product-1-…”.

Rename the “Download All” master bundle ZIP filename to a neutral multi-product bundle name by updating frontend/src/lib/filename.ts (generateAllProductsZipName) so it no longer uses “automation-products-bundle-<date>.zip”.

Remove or replace the footer’s promotional “Built with ❤️ using caffeine.ai” line in frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx with sale-appropriate neutral footer copy that does not include emojis and does not include outbound referral/tracking links.

Harden the UI for sale readiness by adding a user-friendly, English-only global error fallback for unexpected runtime errors in the React app (app shell level), and ensure generation/export failures already surfaced as inline errors remain readable and actionable.

Perform an accessibility and usability polish pass across the main navigation and key actions (header buttons, export download buttons) to ensure clear focus states, keyboard operability, and meaningful accessible names/labels where icons are used.

Polish the default product marketing copy in frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts by improving each product’s name, subtitle, and description for clarity, scanability, and sale readiness, while keeping the same three themes (Digital Planner, Canva Templates, Printable Wall Art) and keeping all user-facing text in English.

Polish and align the in-app instructional messaging to match the updated product positioning and sale-ready tone by updating user-facing copy in frontend/src/components/export/ExportInstructions.tsx (headings, descriptions, step text) while keeping the same structure (tabs and steps) and keeping all text in English.

Polish the generated README messaging inside exported ZIPs to be sale-ready and consistent with the app’s current branding and the three default themes by updating copy in frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts (including removing or rephrasing language like “automated product generator” and ensuring the master README title and contents description are neutral and theme-appropriate), while keeping all text in English.

Update the app’s global theme tokens to reintroduce a subtle, cohesive color accent (not overly saturated) across light and dark themes by adjusting the existing CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css (e.g., background/surface tinting, accent/muted/secondary/ring/border harmony) while preserving readable contrast and the existing Tailwind token mapping.

Apply the refreshed color accents consistently across the main app shell by updating layout styling in frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx (e.g., header/background treatment and main container backdrop) so the app looks more vibrant without changing navigation behavior or layout structure.

Refresh key screen surfaces to pick up the updated accent palette (without changing features): ensure ExportScreen, UnifiedPreviewScreen, StorefrontScreen, StorefrontProductCard, and ProductEditor use consistent accented surface treatments (e.g., muted panels, card hover/focus states, section dividers) that align with the new theme and reduce the “bland” look.

Reintroduce a blue primary action style across the Product Editor experience so primary buttons (e.g., “Generate”, “Generate All Products”) render with a clearly blue background (not purple) and readable contrast in both light and dark themes by updating the global theme tokens in frontend/src/index.css.

Fix the Product Editor page background/surface styling so it does not appear “completely white”; restore an accented/surfaced look (subtle tint/gradient or muted panel treatment) consistent with the app theme when viewing the product editor workspace and editor card(s) (frontend/src/components/products/ProductsWorkspace.tsx and frontend/src/components/products/ProductEditor.tsx).

Make the onboarding/popup Instructions window fully opaque and easy to read by updating frontend/src/components/onboarding/OnboardingInstructionsModal.tsx to apply a solid background and appropriate border/shadow styling to the DialogContent (avoid transparent/translucent content that reduces legibility).

new_feature_requests.summary: Generate complete product files (PDFs and downloadable assets) for three digital AI-automation products for Gumroad/Etsy upload
Build a simple app that generates the PDFs and downloadable assets for the three products
Add a simple in-app preview screen for the generated PDFs
Add step-by-step instructions for using the app and for uploading the generated products to Gumroad and Etsy
Add a short onboarding modal that shows instructions when users first open the app
Add a quick link-out button for exporting the generated product files
Make the onboarding instructions popup/modal resize dynamically to fit different screen sizes (responsive layout)
Add a subtle fade-in animation to the onboarding/instructions popup/modal (especially on tablet)
Provide a unified layout/preview that shows the three products together in one combined view
Add a polished storefront-style view that arranges/presents the three products together for browsing/review
Refine the visual structure of the Storefront screen layout (polish spacing/typography/component arrangement) based on current design
Fully optimize/polish the app end-to-end so it is ready for sale (final UI/UX polish, responsiveness, copy clarity, and overall quality)
Reintroduce a touch of color in the app’s visual layout/theme (current version feels too bland)
